jobs.description:
GC AI https://gc.ai/ is the legal AI platform built for in-house legal teams. Your decisions shape the product, your impact is immediate, and you own your work from day one.

More than 2,000 companies https://gc.ai/customers run their legal work on GC AI, including 200+ public companies, 25+ unicorns, and teams at News Corp, Nestlé, Miro, Bass Pro Shops, Snyk, Skims, Liquid Death, Vercel, Zscaler, and TIME. The platform holds an 80 NPS, more than double the B2B SaaS industry average, which is why GC AI is the leading legal AI platform for companies of all sizes.

GC AI doubled ARR in six months. We raised a $60 million Series B https://gc.ai/blog/gc-ai-raises-60-million-series-b-to-give-every-company-a-legal-advantage at a $555 million valuation in November 2025 and won #1 Highest Customer Satisfaction https://gc.ai/blog/gc-ai-saas-award-winner-2026 at the 2026 SaaS Awards. Our investors include Scale Venture Partners, Northzone, Sound Ventures, and Guillermo Rauch, CEO of Vercel.

You’ll define how things get built, not follow someone else’s playbook. Six principles guide how the team works:

 - 📈 1% Better Every Day: small, compounding improvements across everything you ship.

 - ❤️‍🔥 Customer Obsession: start with the customer and work backward.

 - 🚀 Ship Today: bias toward action and iteration over perfection.

 - 🧗 Find a Way: resourcefulness and ambition over constraint.

 - 🤝 Care: be direct, like an honest friend, even when it’s uncomfortable.

 - 🎯 Own It: full accountability, proactive communication, and attention to detail.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're seeking an exceptional Member of Technical Staff, Applied AI to help lead the development of our cutting-edge AI platform. This is a unique opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence transforms legal work. You'll be the technical cornerstone of our AI initiatives, working directly with our CTO (ex-Replit) team of ex-founders to architect systems that push the boundaries of what's possible with LLMs in the legal domain.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We're at a pivotal moment in legal technology, where AI can fundamentally transform how legal work gets done. As our AI Engineer, you'll be the architect of systems that make this transformation possible. Your work will define not just how our platform evolves, but how an entire industry adapts to and leverages AI. This is a chance to solve novel technical challenges while having a real impact on how legal professionals work.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architect and drive our core AI/LLM infrastructure and features from conception to production.

 - Design and implement AI systems that handle complex legal reasoning and document analysis.

 - Lead the evaluation and integration of LLM capabilities and AI tools.

 - Establish best practices for AI development, and reliability.

 - Build frameworks for rapid prototyping and validation of AI features.

 - Guide and mentor our growing team of AI engineers.

 - Shape our technical strategy and roadmap alongside senior leadership.

 


IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

 - Design and run rigorous legal-grade evals that harden model choices, prompts, and retrieval for accuracy and explainability.

 - Improve real-world outcomes (precision, recall, latency) by advancing RAG, structured reasoning, and tool-use pipelines.

 - Translate domain insights into AI-powered product features that users immediately feel - better answers, fewer edits.

 - Help build the leading legal AI platform for in-house teams.

 


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on AI systems.

 - Deep expertise in LLM implementation and optimization.

 - Strong track record of building production AI systems at scale.

 - Experience with modern AI frameworks and tools.

 - Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers.

 - Strong foundation in TypeScript and modern software architecture.

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience building software.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with RAG systems and LLM evaluation.

 - Familiarity with legal domain or legal text processing.

 - Track record of technical publications or open-source contributions.

 - Experience with multi-agent AI systems.

 


THE MINDSET

 - Problem Solver: You come alive tackling complex challenges without obvious solutions.

 - Ownership-Driven: You take initiative without needing direction and focus on outcomes.

 - Continuous Learner: Your curiosity drives you to constantly level up your engineering skills.

 - Startup DNA: You thrive in fast-paced environments where responsibilities evolve.

 


TRAVEL EXPECTATION

GC AI is distributed, and engineering is our most distributed team. We hire engineers across the US and Canada. Wherever you're based, expect up to 10% travel for coworking sessions and team off-sites across our hub cities.

Because we work across time zones, we prioritize engineers who communicate clearly in writing and operate well asynchronously. Strong written communication is a core part of how we build.




A NOTE ON PACE

We’re building something new in a once-in-a-generation shift in technology and the legal industry, so we move at a relentless pace. We expect urgency, ownership, and good judgment even when things aren’t perfectly clear. If you need structure and consensus to do your best work, this isn’t the right place for you. If you thrive in ambiguity and growth, work with intensity, and want real responsibility, keep reading. We’re excited to meet you.




HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

ABOUT GEORGIAN



Georgian is a Toronto-based venture capital firm that partners with high-growth technology companies across cybersecurity, AI software, robotics, defense. We manage about $6B in assets and we have invested in more than 80 companies that we support with capital and technical capability.



Our in-house AI lab works directly with portfolio companies to provide a differentiated experience across the investment lifecycle, and drives the adoption of AI for our internal operations.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE



Are you an aspiring AI Engineer eager to gain real-world impact and learn how to push AI's boundaries? Imagine diving into diverse, cutting-edge AI problems across multiple high-growth companies with the support of a leading VC firm. That's Georgian.



We're not your typical VC. Georgian's unique R&D team partners directly with our portfolio companies, providing the technical horsepower and strategic guidance to help accelerate their AI initiatives. We also play a critical role in our investment process, conducting deep technical diligence to identify promising AI-driven businesses.



Think of it as working in a dynamic startup environment, but without the inherent risks of a single venture. You'll tackle fascinating challenges, meet and potentially work with brilliant founders and CTOs, and try to help unearth the next generation of industry leaders. It's a fun, engaging, and highly impactful way to build your career.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Georgian's mission is to empower the world's leading B2B software companies with an unfair advantage, accelerating their participation in the digital economy. As an AI Engineer Intern on our R&D team, you'll support this mission by contributing to cutting-edge machine learning projects. You'll assist in bringing machine learning expertise directly to our portfolio companies' most pressing challenges, helping them build and scale potentially transformative AI products. You'll also contribute to our investment process technical diligence, helping us identify innovative and technically sound companies.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN & DELIVER



 - Support AI system development. Assist in building LLM agents, Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and fine‑tuned domain‑specific models under guidance; help implement workflows with frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex/PydanticAI.

 - Contribute to portfolio projects. Support Georgian "strike teams" embedded in portfolio companies; assist with code implementation, testing, and documentation.

 - Technical analysis & documentation. Help convert technical concepts into clear documentation; support preparation of demos and presentations for stakeholders.

 - Hands‑on R&D support. Assist in rapid prototyping, run experiments and ablation studies, contribute to internal tech notes and documentation.

 - Support AI roadmap development. Help gather requirements in discovery workshops, assist in documenting technical specifications and implementation plans.

 - Contribute to safety & governance. Assist in implementing evaluation pipelines and testing frameworks to keep models reliable and compliant.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR




IDEAL ATTRIBUTES

 - Education & Experience: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline with a focus on machine learning, optimization theory, or related areas.

 - Hands-On Foundation: Familiarity with deep learning toolkits such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Understanding of GenAI, LLM tooling and Context Engineering fundamentals.

 - Software Development: Proficiency in Python and foundational software development skills, enabling you to write clean, efficient code.

 - Problem Formulation & Communication: The ability to understand applied research problems, assist in designing experiments, implement solutions, and clearly document findings for diverse audiences with varying technical backgrounds.

 - Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work on team projects, collaborate effectively with technical groups, and communicate progress to mentors and stakeholders.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience contributing to open-source AI/ML-related projects or research papers.

 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for MLOps and model deployment.

 - Exposure to specific industry verticals relevant to Georgian's portfolio (e.g., vertical SaaS, cybersecurity, healthcare tech, fintech).




CULTURAL ATTRIBUTES WE LOVE



 - High ambition & agency: You're allergic to incrementalism and thrive in low‑structure, high‑ownership settings.

 - Insatiable curiosity: You debug the root cause and ask why until everyone else gets annoyed—in a good way.

 - Team over ego: You amplify colleagues and founders alike, seeing leverage in elevating the collective.

 - Commercial storytelling: You speak with brevity and distill complexity so a time‑starved CEO instantly sees value.




HIRING PROCESS



We don't hire like a MAG7 or scale up — in fact we rarely hire compared to them.



You shouldn't expect a cookie-cutter high-volume hiring process with us — but a more boutique one that allows you to see a lot of the organization before joining us.



We build a thesis in what an individual brings to our very small team, versus simply matching qualifications:

 1. 30‑min intro (values & motivations)

 2. 60‑min technical interview (ML fundamentals & problem‑solving)

 3. Project discussion with team members




POSITION STATUS

 

This posting represents an active, future internship vacancy on our team. We will be interviewing for this role in the fall.

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO ACCESSIBILITY



Georgian is dedicated to building an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process to ensure every candidate has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any specific accommodations at any stage, please reach out to us at peopleteam [at] georgian.io.




USE OF AI



Innovation is at our core and we use artificial intelligence (AI) to support parts of our hiring process, such as screening and evaluating applications. These tools are designed to assist - not replace - human decision making and all final hiring decisions are made by our team. We regularly review our AI tools to help promote fairness and reduce the risk of unintended bias. If you have any questions about how we use AI in our process or would like more information, please contact us at careers [at] georgian.io.

Gigi is the agentic operating system of enterprise media buying. Our first product is the AI media manager for Amazon DSP. Since launching it in summer 2025, we've grown to manage hundreds of millions in advertising spend on behalf of the largest agencies in the world.

We're backed by top venture investors Golden Ventures and Aperiam Ventures. Our founding team has spent 15+ years building in Amazon Ads and ecommerce, including a prior $100M+ exit.

We doubled revenue in the past two months. We expect to double again by early Q4.

We're hiring an AI Builder—a full stack software engineer—to join our engineering team in Toronto and own end-to-end feature development for Gigi, our AI agent.

This is still fundamentally a software engineering role. Much of the work will feel familiar: designing APIs, building interfaces, modelling data, integrating services, writing tests, debugging production issues, and making architectural decisions. The main difference is the product we're building: agentic software where LLMs reason, use tools, and take actions on behalf of customers.

You do not need to be an AI researcher or have years of professional LLM experience. Strong full stack engineers who are excited to learn how agentic systems work should apply. You'll use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor as a core part of how you work, while building across agent logic, backend services, data, and the customer-facing product.

This is the 12th role at Gigi. As an early employee, you will have a meaningful role in shaping our product, engineering culture, and company.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Ship end to end. You'll own features from the data layer through the agent logic to the interface a media buyer actually touches. Our stack includes Python, FastAPI, LangGraph and LangChain; TypeScript, Vue and Nuxt; Java and Spring Boot; PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis and NATS; and AWS.

 - Build with AI as a core part of your development workflow. Use Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents to help plan, implement, test, debug, and review software. You are still responsible for the architecture, quality, and correctness of what gets shipped.

 - Build the agent's judgment, not just its plumbing. Decide what Gigi should do autonomously and what it must escalate to a human, then score actions on risk and confidence so recommendations read differently when the data is thin.

 - Draw the line between probabilistic and deterministic work. LLMs for reasoning, structured software for execution. Knowing where that boundary sits on any given feature is a daily call, not a settled architecture.

 - Build reliable agentic systems. You'll learn to design tools, retrieval, memory, evaluations, guardrails, and human approval flows that make Gigi dependable enough to take action inside real advertising accounts. Prior experience with all of these is not expected.

 - Work directly with customers. You'll sit in on calls, read transcripts, and take feedback straight from the media buyers using the product. You'll turn ambiguous customer problems into shipped product without waiting for a perfect spec.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 30 days. Your code is in production. You understand what a media buyer's day actually involves and why the product is shaped the way it is.

 - Six months. You own a surface area of the product outright. When something breaks in it, or a customer asks for something new, you're the person who decides what happens.

 - Twelve months. You've shipped something we could not have built without you, and you've thrown out at least one thing you built because the abstraction was wrong.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A track record of building and shipping production software used by real customers. We care more about what you have built and owned than an exact number of years.

 - Strong full stack software engineering experience. The fundamentals you already have—system design, APIs, data models, interfaces, testing, debugging, and operating production software—transfer directly to this role.

 - Comfort across the stack. Real depth somewhere, no allergy to the parts you're weaker in.

 - Experience using, or a strong desire to become highly effective with, AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools. You do not need to be an expert on day one, but you should be excited to use them every day—and strong enough technically to review their work, reject weak abstractions, catch missing edge cases, and remain accountable for what ships.

 - Curiosity about how LLMs change software products and the way software gets built. You should be excited to develop good judgment around where AI belongs—and where conventional software is the better answer.

 - Judgment over specification. You can make a reasoned call, ship it, and iterate fast when it's wrong.

 - Speed and ownership. LLMs changed what “fast” means for a small team. You should be comfortable using AI coding agents to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for architecture, correctness, and maintainability.


WHAT YOU DON'T NEED

 - You do not need an AI research background or experience training foundation models. We build products around existing models, combining them with tools, data, business logic, interfaces, and production infrastructure.

 - You do not need prior experience with every agent framework or concept we use. We expect strong engineers to learn LangGraph, agent orchestration, evaluations, retrieval, and tool use on the job.

 - You do not need prior advertising or Amazon DSP experience. Our team will help you learn the domain.


BONUS POINTS IF

 - You've built with LLMs in production: evals, guardrails, tool use, retrieval, agent orchestration, cost and latency work.

 - You've worked in advertising or ecommerce.

 - You've built real-time data pipelines at meaningful volume, or been early enough at a startup to know what the first 20 people actually do.

 - You've operated production systems where correctness, permissions, auditability, or customer trust mattered.


THE HARD PARTS

We'd rather you know this before you apply.

 - We work hard. We are trying to build a generational company, and early employees should expect intensity, ambiguity, and high standards.

 - Cash compensation is competitive for our stage, but we will not win every late-stage salary comparison. The upside is meaningful ownership and equity in a company growing quickly.

 - We throw out working code when the underlying abstraction is wrong. Some of what you build will not survive, and you'll be the one who calls it.

 - Nobody is siloed. You'll write frontend, debug backend, think through product, join customer calls, and solve whatever problem is blocking the customer.


COMPENSATION AND EQUITY

 - Base salary: $110k to $200k depending on experience level

 - Meaningful equity. We want to be as generous with equity as possible, and top performers can expect equity top-ups early and often.


LIFE AT GIGI

 - In-office culture. We work together downtown Toronto, but makers (i.e. engineers) can choose to work where they are most productive on Wednesdays.

 - Catered lunch every day from Toronto's best spots. Current rotation: Impact Kitchen, iQ Food Co., ChopHop, and Cumbrae's.

 - Real snacks: Greek yogurt, Mateína yerba mate, Barebells protein bars, Midday Squares. Tell us what you want and we'll add it.

 - Top-of-the-line Apple equipment.

 - Comprehensive health and dental coverage.

JOB TITLE: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER 


LOCATION: CANADA (EAST COAST)




MEET TEAM VECTOR:

Team Vector builds the AI that talks directly to the customers of banks and credit unions. When someone calls their credit union to check a balance, dispute a charge, or ask about a loan, it’s our agent on the other end of the line.

Our vision: To build the world’s most intuitive and trusted customer-facing banking AI agents

Our mission: To build and scale a fully agentic voice AI framework that drives high-value customer interactions. We unify our runtime architecture, remove configuration friction, and keep our existing systems fully stable so customers never see a disruption.




WHY THIS WORK IS INTERESTING:

Voice AI with very low latency. People notice every pause in a conversation. We aim for the best voice AI experience available, which means working to shave milliseconds off every hop: speech recognition, LLM inference, tool calls, and speech synthesis. Latency is a first-class engineering constraint for us, not an afterthought.

LLM architecture under real constraints. Banking is one of the most regulated places to put an LLM in front of a customer. Every response has to be safe, accurate, compliant, and on-brand, and it still has to feel natural. That calls for a detailed harness around the model: guardrails, grounding, policy enforcement, verification layers, and controlled agentic flows. Building those controls without giving up speed or conversational quality is one of the hardest and most interesting problems in applied AI right now.

Real impact at scale. The agents you build will handle real conversations for real people across hundreds of financial institutions. What you ship matters.

A global team. Team Vector works across Europe and Vancouver, Canada, and collaborates closely with teams on both continents. You’ll work with experienced engineers who care about craft and move quickly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Design, build, and ship the core of our agentic voice AI framework, from conversation orchestration to tool calling and runtime architecture.

 - Build and evolve the harness controls (guardrails, grounding, policy checks, evaluation) that make our LLM agents trustworthy enough for banking.

 - Work on latency end to end: profile, measure, and optimize every stage of the real-time voice pipeline.

 - Help unify our runtime architecture and remove configuration friction so new banking use cases can launch quickly.

 - Keep our existing production systems stable and reliable while we build what comes next.

 - Work with product, design, and engineering teams across Europe and Vancouver to turn ambiguous problems into shipped outcomes.

 - Use AI-assisted development tools daily and help set the standards for how we review and verify agent-generated code.
 


OUR TECH STACK:

 - Coding languages: Python, Elixir, TypeScript, React (JavaScript)

 - Persistence: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3

 - Infrastructure: AWS

 - Monitoring: DataDog

 - CI/CD: Jenkins, Argo CD

 - AI: Gemini, Claude Code

 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

 - Other: Kafka, GitHub, Kubernetes, Docker
 
 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

AI Systems Experience: A core requirement. You have built production AI systems before and you understand LLM architecture well: prompting and context management, tool use and agentic flows, retrieval and grounding, evaluation, and the tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality. Real-time or voice AI experience is a strong plus, and so is experience with agent SDKs (such as the Claude Agent SDK or OpenAI Agents SDK).

Architecture & Technical Judgment: You own the design of complex components, make sound tradeoffs, and spot risk early. When AI writes more of the code, system design becomes the scarce and highly valued skill.

Excellent: Trusted, Fast Delivery: You ship fast without cutting corners. You have a track record of reliable outcomes, de-risking projects, and owning quality, including verifying and standing behind agent-generated code.

Applied AI Fluency: You actively use tools like Claude to design, build, review, and ship. You can direct agents, verify their output, and you know where they help and where they don’t.

Proactive: You see problems before they’re assigned to you and act on them. You partner with PMs to take projects from idea to delivery, and you raise issues, propose solutions, and drive them forward without waiting to be asked.

Adaptable: You do well in a fast-paced environment where priorities, tools, and the AI landscape itself change quickly. You adjust without losing momentum.

Curious: Learning Velocity: You’re hungry to learn. You run at unfamiliar problems, pick up new tools and practices quickly, and share what you learn with the people around you.

Cross-Continental Collaboration: You communicate clearly in writing and in person, and you do well on a distributed team. You can reliably overlap at least 2 hours a day with Pacific Time (9:00–11:00 AM PT) to work closely with teammates in Vancouver.

Leadership Instincts: You set direction, unblock people, and raise the bar without micromanaging. Ideally, you bring prior tech lead, team lead, or mentorship experience

The Team

You'll be joining our dedicated Observability Team, which builds the observability platform and SRE tooling used to monitor Glia’s cloud-native core infrastructure serving the conversational AI. Our team focuses on enablement and automation: we provide the standards, tooling, and platform that engineering teams use to keep their own systems available and performing optimally.



The Mission & The Work

As a Site Reliability Engineer on this team, your focus will be on building SRE and observability tooling — the platform, automation, and standards other teams use to keep their services healthy. This is a tooling and enablement role, not a production operations role: you will not be directly operating Glia’s production services. Responsibilities will include:

 - Developing standards, infrastructure and automation for dashboards, alerts, and monitors as code.

 - Partnering with development teams to establish production readiness and operational readiness.

 - Building the tooling and templates teams use to define, measure, and report on Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) for their services.

 - Developing tooling to automate observability and operational workflows, eliminating manual toil for engineering teams.

 - Building and improving the incident response tooling and workflows that help teams resolve outages faster and learn from them.



Our Collaboration Model

Glia Engineering is remote-first, spanning Canada, Portugal, Poland, and Estonia. The Observability team is based in Estonia, with optional offices in Tallinn and Tartu. We thrive on flexible remote collaboration, but we still bring the whole team together in Estonia twice a year for in-person innovation and connection.



Our tech stack

 - Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), Istio, EFK

 - Persistence: Amazon Aurora Serverless for Postgres, RabbitMQ, Amazon RDS

 - Cache: Amazon ElastiCache

 - Monitoring & Observability: DataDog with a focus on dashboards and alerts for system health

 - CI/CD: Github Actions, ArgoCD, Jenkins, Helm, with a focus on automation and pipeline optimization.

 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

 - Additionally, our Engineering teams use:
 
 - Backend: Python, Elixir, Node.js http://node.js, Ruby, Go
 
 - Frontend: Javascript and React.js
 
 - Native mobile SDKs: Java and Swift



What We’re Looking for

 - Expert-level proficiency with AWS and Kubernetes (EKS), particularly in areas of observability, networking, and auto-scaling.

 - Experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus) and a deep understanding of metrics, logging, and tracing.

 - Deep, practical understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles (SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction).

 - Demonstrable experience analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.

 - Strong software development skills in a language like Python or Go, used to build operational tools, services, or automation.

 - Expertise in designing and operating robust CI/CD pipelines for a microservices architecture (e.g., using ArgoCD, Github Actions, Helm).

 - A systematic, data-driven approach to problem-solving and root cause analysis.

 - Proficiency in using AI tools thoughtfully, maintaining ownership of the final output while recognizing the tools' limitations.

 - Research, brainstorm, and pitch creative and compelling article topics

 - Work with our internal teams to identify opportunities and plan improvements to existing content and internal processes

ABOUT US:

Ground News https://ground.news/ is a platform that makes it easy to compare news sources, read between the lines of media bias, and break free from algorithms.

In a world where political polarization and media distrust are at an all-time high, Ground News offers people a better way to stay informed and see every side of the story. Our mobile app, web app, and browser extension are home to a community of mindful readers who use our news comparison platform to engage with news beyond their filter bubble.

Unlike most news companies, our values do not align with any specific political ideology. Unlike most tech platforms, we don’t rely on algorithms to keep users on our platform to sell more ads. We are supported by our readers who pay for a subscription to build a more nuanced understanding of the news, the world, and themselves.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY: SENIOR DATA ENGINEER

As a senior Data Engineer, you'll build the analytical foundation that Ground News runs on. You'll sit within our ML chapter and work out of the Platform & Infrastructure pod, splitting your time between developing the integrations that bring data into our warehouse and analytical layers that serve KPIs for our Growth & Monetization, Core Experience, and Content Intelligence pods.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in reusable models across the org. You'll design scalable, conformed data models that let analysts answer their own questions without waiting on you, and you'll own the reliability of those models end to end: ingestion, data quality, accuracy, coverage gaps, and failures both upstream and downstream. When a number looks wrong, you're the person who can trace it from the event that produced it to the dashboard that reported it.

You'll also be a key liaison between the people who ask the questions and the systems that answer them, translating what analysts, customer success, and product stakeholders need into data they can trust and reuse.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Design and build scalable, conformed data models and analytical layers that serve experimentation and company KPIs.

 - Own the connectors that land data in the warehouse end to end, from replicated backend tables to custom connectors you build yourself and third-party managed sources.

 - Manage infrastructure as code and deployment workflows across AWS and GCP, using Kubernetes and OpenTofu (Terraform) to ship changes safely.

 - Own the pipelines you build, monitoring freshness and responding to failures with urgency.

 - Act as a senior voice in data architecture decisions, from selecting table types and datastores to designing the schemas from backend to semantic layers.

 - Partner directly with analysts, ML engineers, and product stakeholders to turn business questions into data models they can self-serve from.

 - Champion high engineering quality through testing, code reviews, observability, and thoughtful operational practices.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience building and operating production data platforms and analytical models.

 - Deep expertise in SQL and Python.

 - Broad experience with dimensional modelling: grain, table types, conformed dimensions, and load patterns.

 - Hands-on experience with modern data tooling: BigQuery, dbt, Dagster, and ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, or Google Datastream.

 - Experience with data stores and event-driven systems such as PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and message queues or streams (Kafka, SQS, or Pub/Sub).

 - SRE-oriented experience: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and performance optimization for data integrations.

 - Experience shipping data and metrics safely, with the validation habits to keep wrong numbers off dashboards and an eye on the compute cost behind them.



WHY WORK AT GROUND?

Co-founded by a former NASA engineer and Bain consultant, a position with Ground News provides an unparalleled learning experience both personally and professionally. At Ground, we prioritize growth: both for our business and team members. You’ll have the freedom to work remotely and play a key role in the development of Ground News products.

This is an opportunity to work with a growing and mighty team that is fighting every day to build a world where cooperative, civil debate is the norm, media is accountable, and critical thought is the baseline of our information consumption. Ground is based in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada, but this role is remote.

Our culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding accessibility needs, please contact talent@ground.news, and a member of our team will be happy to help.

In this role, you will own the solution end-to-end: uncovering opportunities, architecting integrations, orchestrating AI models, and proving measurable ROI in weeks, not months. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position at the intersection of technology, strategy, and execution.

 


OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE

 - Lead end-to-end technical delivery for enterprise engagements, from discovery through deployment.

 - Embed with client teams to scope high-value workflows, architect integrations, and orchestrate AI models.

 - Partner with internal Product, Data Science, and Backend teams to deliver scalable, explainable, and reliable AI integrations.

 - Collaborate with strategic consulting partners to align technical efforts with client business goals and expansion opportunities.

 - Capture learnings and build reusable patterns, documentation, and internal playbooks to accelerate future deployments.

 - Communicate effectively with senior executives, advocating for optimal AI workflow strategies while gathering feedback for continuous improvement.

 - Partner with sales and customer success to ensure smooth onboarding, adoption, and expansion of workflows.

 - 5+ years in a hybrid technical + client-facing role (e.g., Solution Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, AI/ML Systems Engineer, Technical Consultant).

 - Competitive compensation and equity in a rapidly growing company

 - 401K Matching

 - Remote or Hybrid Work Schedule (Office located in Flatiron District, New York, NY)

 - Pet-friendly office

 

This role can be based out of our New York office or performed fully remotely in the United States or Canada.

About Us

Gumloop is the multiplayer AI agent builder. We believe the people who know the work best should be able to automate it, and use what they build to help their whole team do more.



Anyone at a company can build, share, and optimize agents with any AI model and any integration. Teams can orchestrate those agents across their business, while IT keeps full control over data, access, and spend.



We're a small team building as fast as humanly possible. Gusto, Ramp, Shopify, Samsara, Instacart, and Opendoor are running agents on Gumloop across their company. We've raised over $70M https://www.gumloop.com/blog/series-b from Benchmark, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, Nexus Ventures to scale and are looking for people who care as much as we do to join the team.



Here’s what life at Gumloop is like:

 - Our beliefs – The Handbook https://www.gumloop.com/handbook

 - Our adventures – Wall of Photos https://www.gumloop.com/photos

 - What our users are saying - Wall of Love https://www.gumloop.com/love

 - What we’re working on – Changelog https://www.gumloop.com/changelog
 
 




ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a Design Engineer to help shape, design, and build high-craft product experiences end to end. This role sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You’ll own key user-facing surfaces from early concept through final implementation, using strong product judgment, thoughtful interaction design, and excellent frontend execution to make complex workflows feel simple. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating with high ownership. You should be able to take a product problem, reason through the UX, design the interface, build the frontend, and collaborate with engineering when backend support is needed. You’ll also help evolve our design system and establish reusable patterns that make the product better over time, and allow the rest of our engineering team to build beautiful interfaces. 
This is a high-impact role for someone who wants direct influence over what we build, how it works, and how it feels.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build polished, user-facing product experiences across core surfaces of the product.

 - Own features end to end, from product thinking and UX exploration through implementation and iteration.

 - Use layout, interaction design, and motion to make powerful workflows feel intuitive and fast.

 - Contribute to and evolve our design system, component library, and frontend patterns.

 - Work closely with product, design, and engineering to turn ambiguous ideas into simple, high-quality experiences.

 - Bring strong craft to the details: accessibility, performance, reliability, responsive behavior, and edge cases.

 - Partner with other engineers, and when needed contribute across the stack to bring features fully across the finish line.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2–5+ years of experience building user-facing products in high-ownership environments.

 - Strong experience with TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend development.

 - Experience contributing to or building a design system, component library, or reusable frontend patterns.

 - A track record of owning product work end to end with limited handholding.

 - Strong product intuition and the ability to make thoughtful UX decisions independently.

 - Care for craft beyond the first 80%, including performance, accessibility, reliability, and visual polish.

 - A systems-first mindset and interest in building durable patterns that help the whole team move faster.


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience in developer tools, technical products, or AI-native products.

 - Familiarity with Next.js, TanStack Query, TanStack Table, TanStack Form, Zod, or Motion/React.

 - Experience working with CMS platforms or SEO-oriented product surfaces.

 - Comfort using design tools like Figma, Paper, or similar tools to explore and communicate ideas.

 - Full-stack capability, especially enough backend fluency to independently unblock product work.


BENEFITS

 - Highly competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Generous paid time off: 24 days for SF employees and 20 days globally, use them as you need

 - $350/month wellness benefit to spend on gym, spa, equipment, or whatever keeps you at your best

 - 15 days of temporary remote work flexibility per year

 - 401k match up to 6%

About Us

Gumloop is the multiplayer AI agent builder. We believe the people who know the work best should be able to automate it, and use what they build to help their whole team do more.



Anyone at a company can build, share, and optimize agents with any AI model and any integration. Teams can orchestrate those agents across their business, while IT keeps full control over data, access, and spend.



We're a small team building as fast as humanly possible. Gusto, Ramp, Shopify, Samsara, Instacart, and Opendoor are running agents on Gumloop across their company. We've raised over $70M https://www.gumloop.com/blog/series-b from Benchmark, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, Nexus Ventures to scale and are looking for people who care as much as we do to join the team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Brand Designer at Gumloop, you own the visual identity of the company.

This is a high-ownership role for a creative who sweats the details and has built an aesthetic philosophy through years of high-level work. You will work directly with product and marketing, holding the highest craft bar at the company.




IDENTITY

Trust in a Autonomy

When software acts on your behalf, every touchpoint either builds confidence or erodes it. Our brand is the interface for building this trust. How we name things, how we explain what an agent did, the visuals that communicate what's happening under the hood. All of it shapes whether someone feels comfortable letting go of the wheel.

Multiplayer as a Multiplier

AI adoption doesn't scale through mandates, it spreads through people. One person's effort building an agent empowers their team, then amplifies across their company. Our brand should make that spread feel inevitable, every effort should be worth showing off.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Shape the core narrative of the Gumloop brand across every external and internal facing touchpoint.

 - Define a unique direction and style for communicating technical ideas through clear, compelling visuals.

 - Take ownership over every small detail, no matter how small.

 - Own projects end-to-end, from concept through launch, working directly with product and marketing.

 - Distill actionable insights from brand feedback and conversations, then turn them into work.

 - Hold the highest bar of craft at the company.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience creating original brand work that demonstrates exceptional visual craft and strong creative direction.

 - Strong opinions about how a brand should make others feel, but have self-awareness.

 - Ability to clearly articulate why something works, and why it doesn’t.

 - Experience operating independently, setting or significantly evolving a company’s visual identity, ideally as a solo designer, early design hire, independent practitioner, or highly autonomous studio designer.

 - Aptitude for learning new tools that enable you to express creative ideas.

 - Judgment into when work meets the bar, needs another round, and when good is enough to keep momentum.

 - Motion design or animation experience.

 - Experience developing characters, illustration systems, or brand mascots.

 - Experience creating brands for AI, technical audiences, developers, or enterprise software products.

 - $350/month wellness benefit to spend on gym, spa, equipment, or whatever keeps you at your best

 - Long-horizon (1000+ step) planning agents for mission-critical workflows.
 
 - Government-grade security for highly sensitive data.
 
 - Evaluation of LLMs across a 10k+ leaf taxonomy of tasks.

 - A proven ability to design and operate backend platforms that support multiple product lines at scale.

 - Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React) or backend systems (e.g. Python, Node, Go).

 - A strong product instinct and attention to detail, with a track record of building intuitive, high-quality user experiences.

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.



ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer at Harvey, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the foundation of our product platform while directly building user-facing features for some of the world’s leading law firms and enterprise customers. This team owns and operates the platform layer that enables secure, reliable, and flexible experiences for our customers including notifications, permissions and feature flag infrastructure. We also build enterprise-grade collaboration product experiences for law firms.



You will design and own systems that not only serve as critical infrastructure for the rest of the company, but also directly impact how our users engage with Harvey’s AI-powered legal tools. This role is ideal for engineers who are excited by the opportunity to move between deep platform thinking and hands-on product iteration.



This role is based in Toronto, Canada. We use a hybrid, 3+ days-per week in-person work model and offer relocation assistance to new employees.




WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - Design and build foundational infrastructure including authentication, permissions, feature flagging, notifications, and document management integrations

 - Build and evolve Harvey’s internal product platform, accelerating development across multiple product lines and engineering teams

 - Lead development of enterprise-facing features, such as secure multi-party collaboration, cross-organization workflows, and robust admin controls

 - Maintain high standards for security, privacy, and system reliability, particularly in handling sensitive legal data

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, AI, design, and GTM teams to deliver delightful, enterprise-ready experiences




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ YoE (post-BS/MS) in a product focused full-stack software engineering role.

 - Experience with React, Typescript, CSS (we use TailwindCSS), Python, or related.

 - Track record of building fast-growing SaaS products by leveraging PWA technologies.

 - Track record of shipping highly intuitive products, strong attention to detail.

 - Experience building backend platforms that can support multiple product lines.

 - Strong programming skills and general Computer Science knowledge.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Be part of building something special as a founding member of our Toronto team

 - Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in our Toronto office, 2 days working from home




COMPENSATION

CAD $196,800 – $295,200


We are an AI company and we use AI to improve all of our processes, including in the recruitment process. Whilst we do use AI to help improve efficiency in our recruitment process, we do not rely on AI to make any automated decisions and ensure that a human reviews AI output.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Headstart https://www.headstart.nyc/ is built for people who want to think like founders. We work inside real enterprises ($100M+ ARR), shipping production AI systems that change how they operate. Every engagement is a different industry, problem, and set of constraints. We're bootstrapped, cash-flow positive, and growing fast, and we're building our own platform to deliver truly agentic systems.




WHY JOIN US

Enterprise clients bring us messy, high-stakes problems, often with no clear picture of what the AI system should be. Our engineers work out what to build, build it, and run it in production. Most of the time, they're the experts in the room.

This role is part player, part coach, part staffing partner. Most of your time stays on a client engagement, hands-on, close to the work and to where engineers get stuck. You'll manage a group of engineers across a few engagements and grow with the team as we do.

Level: Reports to the Head of Engineering. You run a team inside our system: you apply the bar, keep your engineers growing, and stay close to the work.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Your engineers. Manage engineers up to senior, hold a high bar, and give direct, actionable feedback. Coach on execution and help strong engineers step up toward tech lead.

 - Technical leadership. Review architecture, agent, prompt, and eval design on your engagements. Step into hard technical and client situations, like production regressions and unclear requirements, and make the call. Raise trouble early, while it's cheap to fix.

 - Engagement delivery. Run the engagement-level relationship with clients and their stakeholders, alongside product and client partners, so each engagement lands.

 - Staffing. Manage transitions on your team, plan ahead, and flag risks before they reach a client. Escalate conflicts across engagements to the Head of Engineering.

 - Hiring. Interview, calibrate, close, and onboard new engineers against the bar the Head of Engineering sets.

 - Practice. Follow the team's practices and tell us what isn't working. Bring patterns you see to the wider team so they can become standing practice, and make sure your engineers use what exists.
 
 


YOUR BACKGROUND

 - 3+ years managing engineers, with real experience giving feedback and developing people.

 - 5+ years in software engineering, deep enough to review designs and challenge the team's approach. Hands-on with Python.

 - Experience delivering software in real client environments.

 - Curious about agents, evals, and multi-agent systems, with a sense of where they're reliable and where a person needs to take the wheel. Fluent with AI coding tools. Depth matters more than prior title.

Bonus: management experience in a consulting, services, or forward deployed engineering organization, or experience taking a team or practice from zero to one.




HOW WE WORK

High trust, high agency, low ego. We push back when something isn't right and share what we learn, so good instincts spread fast.

 - We are our first client. We built Friday, our coding agent, and Statum, our knowledge infrastructure, and we run them on ourselves.

 - AI-first, human-accountable. Agents write nearly all our client code. Every output is reviewed, and the person is accountable.

 - Partners, not a vendor. You're in the room when hard calls get made, and you're expected to have a point of view.

 - Breadth that compounds. You'll see more industries and problems in a year than most people see in a career.

 - Weekends are yours. Pay is transparent, and we don't confuse long hours with good work.



WHAT TO EXPECT

 1. Initial screen (30 min): with our recruiting partner.

 2. Technical screen (30 min): a short, real-world coding exercise with an engineer.

 3. Hiring manager interview (45 min): behavioral and past work.

 4. Technical interviews (2.5 hrs, two sessions): coding and systems design. Use AI tools in the coding interview, since it reflects how we work.

 5. Case study (75 min): a live, scenario-based discussion covering staffing, feedback, technical review, and closing the loop. No prep needed.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Base salary of $285,000 USD plus competitive equity

 - 401k with 4.5% employer match, and fully covered medical, dental, and vision premiums

 - Monthly wellness stipend, Citi Bike, and pre-tax commuter benefits

 - 12 weeks parental leave, with an optional 4-week ramp-up at 50%

 - Loft office in Soho with lunch and snacks

 - Hybrid in NYC. We're open to fully remote candidates in the US or Canada.

ABOUT US

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.



We are seeking Senior Software Engineers to contribute to our core geometric modeling technologies that support design, presentation, and analysis of homes. We are remote-first, this role can sit anywhere in the continental US or Canada.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Expect to:

 - Conceive and implement algorithmic solutions to the most difficult geometric modeling problems

 - Work closely with other engineers, product, and customer success teams to define expected behavior, discover gaps in existing product, and ultimately ensure customers are happy

 - Write tests to verify that your code can handle the worst corner cases.

 - Mentor junior developers to write code as robust as yours.
 


ABOUT YOU

The right candidate for this role prioritizes working software over perfection and wants to deliver code, get user feedback, and iterate. Your ability to be hands-on, while also focusing on the bigger strategic picture, sets us apart. You're not hesitant to deeply understand our codebase to contribute effectively to it.

You have:

 - 5+ years of experience working in CAD or geometric modeling

 - Knowledge of geometric modeling concepts techniques such as but not limited to meshes, BReps, NURBS, and BSPs.

 - Able to understand and navigate a large TypeScript + React codebase

 - Professional fluency with modern development tools, including AI-assisted workflows, paired with clear ownership of the correctness, maintainability, and behavior of the code you produce.

 - Excellent communication within a dynamic organization — highlighting tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and making decisions considering various alternatives

 - Ideally you have a strong interest in the homebuilding industry, whether it's a passion for homes, construction, or home design and you’re motivated by the prospect of elevating an entire industry through geometric modeling.
 

While we've identified the core experience and skills required above, please still apply if you have more or different experience than this! We will use your previous experience and performance across the series of interviews to establish appropriate level within our organization in a fair and equitable way.




WORKING AT HIGHARC

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process. 

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D. 

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

The Associate Product Manager ("APM") works within the Product Management Team. The APM works across Product, Design, Engineering, Operations, Compliance and external data providers to understand problems, evaluate opportunities, define solutions, support delivery, launch improvements and measure whether they created the intended customer and business outcomes.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Ownership & Delivery

 - Own defined product initiatives, improvements, checks or IDV workstreams from discovery through launch and post-launch measurement, with coaching from a Senior Product Manager or Product Leader.

 - Partner with Design and Engineering to evaluate solution options, clarify trade-offs and ensure work is ready for development.

 - Participate actively in planning, refinement, demos and retrospectives; maintain clear decisions, scope and follow-ups for assigned initiatives.

 - Coordinate and perform product acceptance testing to confirm functionality, edge cases, data integrity and launch readiness.

 - Prepare release notes, internal enablement materials and product demos as appropriate.

 - Own post-launch follow-up for assigned initiatives and recommend iteration, remediation or end-of-lifecycle actions based on results.



Discovery & Problem Solving

 - Investigate customer, applicant and operational problems using quantitative data, qualitative feedback, workflow observation and input from Engineering and Operations.

 - Investigate recurring product-health issues such as failed or stuck transactions, low completion or verification rates, workflow friction and reliability gaps; summarize root cause and recommend action.

 - Conduct customer, market and competitor research for assigned problem spaces and synthesize findings into product recommendations.

 - Create user journeys, process flows or lightweight prototypes when they improve shared understanding of a problem or proposed solution.

 - Use AI tools effectively to accelerate research, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, requirements development and workflow exploration, while applying appropriate judgment and validation.

 - Build an understanding of background-check fulfillment and IDV workflows, including third-party data sources, applicant experiences, exceptions, manual processes and operational dependencies.

 - Use product and operational data to understand performance and support prioritization decisions.

 - Define and monitor success measures for assigned initiatives with coaching from the Senior Product Manager.

 - Identify opportunities to improve automation, completion and verification rates, turnaround time, reliability, operational effort, support volume and gross margin

 - Contribute evidence and recommendations to roadmap planning; identify high-value iterative improvements within assigned areas.

 - Follow up on launched changes to determine whether the intended outcome was achieved and what should happen next.

 - Build effective working relationships across Product, Design, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Customer Support, GTM and other internal stakeholders.

 - Work with external data providers, identity partners and technology vendors to understand capabilities, APIs, limitations, service dependencies and integration opportunities.

BONUS

 - Experience working with APIs, webhooks, integrations, data flows or third-party technology/data providers.

Our proprietary platform infuses automation technology and creativity to empower anyone to make the best custom products in any size, shape and quantity. Businesses and consumers can elevate their marketing, packaging, décor or boost their personal expression with our professional-grade products. We believe in the enormous power of customization. We are a smart, creative, helpful and passionate group dedicated to growing the most talented and engaging people in Toronto, Canada. We are a global company utilizing software and advanced digital manufacturing. We proudly make custom products locally. We make what matters stick!




THE ROLE

As a key member of StickerYou’s growing Development Department, we’re looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer. This person will report directly to the VP of Technology & Digital Products. This position will heavily collaborate with our VP of Marketing, and work collaboratively with other teams. This person will drive the user experience strategy for the StickerYou.com http://StickerYou.com e-commerce site by working both independently and collaboratively with others. This person will be challenged to use their critical thinking and problem-solving skills to come up with creative solutions that improve the user experience across all channels.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Craft the overall user experience strategy, design system, and content architecture for the site

 - Oversee a complete overhaul of site journeys and navigation

 - Create end-to-end designs including low-fidelity user interface sketches/wireframes through to high-fidelity pixel perfect visual design mockups and prototypes

 - Monitor analytics on user behaviour and site performance, continuously seeking opportunities to deliver a superior and higher converting experience

 - Develop a proficient understanding of StickerYou's products, customers and competition by leading and participating in user research, competitive analysis and other design thinking activities

 - Apply user-centered design best practices and methodologies as well as mobile-first/responsive design thinking

 - Work within tight deadlines without compromising quality

 - Individual contributor role




WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 5+ years in UX Design, Digital Product Design or Visual/UI design

 - A strong portfolio of projects which demonstrate creative, user-centered design solutions to complex problems, especially in an e-commerce context

 - Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Design, User Experience or a related field

 - High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

 - Ability to take responsibility for design of solutions from concept to completion

 - Ability to communicate clearly and effectively across departments

 - Proficient and effective use of industry-standard UX and UI design tools, including Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite and XD and UXPin

 - Understanding of HTML/CSS/JS capabilities and limitations

 - Knowledge of printing industry considered an asset

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Design, HCI, Psychology, or a related field is an asset




KEY ATTRIBUTES WE LOOK FOR

High Standards: You are organized and self-motivated. You ensure your work adheres to corporate and industry standards.

Problem Solving: You have the ability to view problems from a holistic perspective and focus on finding sustainable and efficient solutions, thinking through possible implications and results from both the business and customer perspective. Balances the strategic and tactical.

Aptitude for Learning: You are a quick learner who looks for opportunities to find new and better ways to do things. You are eager to expand your knowledge of accounting and our operations.

Team Player: You communicate openly, timely and in a clear manner any issue with your manager, co-workers and anyone else who needs or uses the information you manage.

Strong Sense of Initiative: You have the ability to work both independently and collaborate with others. You are able to communicate and balance tight deadlines and tasks from multiple departments without sacrificing quality.




WHY STICKERYOU?

 - A high-growth hybrid print/technology company

ABOUT ZIPLINE

Zipline is a well-funded, rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how frontline teams work. We empower the world’s leading brands across retail, healthcare, logistics, and beyond to connect, align, and inspire their employees- from headquarters to the front lines. Our customers consistently give us best-in-class NPS and CSAT scores, and they rave about how Zipline makes their teams’ lives easier and their businesses more effective. We’re also a fully remote company, with passionate employees across the U.S., Canada, and around the globe.

Please note: Zipline is 100% remote and accepts applicants from Canada, US & internationally. This role would require you to support both our EU and North American markets.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as the technical advisor for customers throughout their lifecycle, partnering closely with Account Management, Sales, Solutions Consulting, Product, and Engineering to deliver technical solutions that maximize customer value.

This role is responsible for leading customer-facing technical services, including integrations, identity management, data services, and technical consultation. The TAM also serves as a trusted internal resource, supporting revenue-generating opportunities, delivering professional services engagements, and acting as the highest level of technical escalation for complex customer implementations.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, building strong customer relationships, collaborating across teams, and translating complex technical concepts into practical business solutions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Integration Services

 - Lead the implementation and delivery of standard and custom customer integrations.

 - Configure and support identity management solutions including SSO, SAML, SCIM, and Just-in-Time (JIT) provisioning.

 - Execute customer identity migrations post-launch such as UserPass to SSO, SAML to SCIM, switching of Identify Providers, etc.

 - Coordinate custom API integration projects with customers and Engineering teams.

 - Manage technical implementation timelines while ensuring successful customer outcomes.
 



Data Services

 - Deliver customer implementations for GraphQL API integrations supporting Metrics Widgets.

 - Configure and support Resource Library sFTP integrations when implemented post-launch.

 - Implement and support Data Connector (BigQuery) integrations.

 - Lead implementation of advanced data exchange solutions and other future data products.

 - Consult with customers on data architecture and API best practices.



Customer Technical Consultation

 - Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.

 - Conduct customer consultation sessions around:
 
 - Custom API integrations
 
 - Integration architecture
 
 - Reporting capabilities
 
 - Data services
 
 - Platform best practices

 - Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

 - Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows through integrations and automation.



Internal Technical Consulting

 - Partner with Sales and Solutions Consulting during the sales cycle by answering technical questions, participating in discovery sessions and reviewing integration and API functionality.

 - Support Account Managers with technical strategy for integration and data services upsell opportunities.

 - Provide consultation on reporting capabilities, Metabase functionality, and available technical solutions for existing customers.

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering to communicate customer feedback and influence future platform enhancements.



Technical Escalations & Support

 - Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex integration and API-related customer issues.

 - Troubleshoot authentication, provisioning, API, and data synchronization challenges.

 - Partner with Engineering to investigate, prioritize, and resolve complex technical issues.

 - Ensure customers receive timely communication and resolution throughout technical investigations.



Documentation & Enablement

 - Develop and maintain customer-facing API, integration, and technical documentation.

 - Partner with Engineering to improve documentation for existing and new integrations.

 - Create internal documentation and best practices to improve technical enablement across Customer Success, Sales, and Solutions Consulting.

 - Share technical knowledge with internal teams through training and consultation.



Special Projects

 - Lead strategic technical initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and customer stakeholders.

 - Support other high-impact technical initiatives across the business as needed.

 - Manage complex technical implementations requiring detailed project management and stakeholder coordination.

 - Participate in approved strategic projects as prioritized by leadership.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Must-Haves

 - 4+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Technical Consulting, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, or a similar customer-facing technical role within a B2B SaaS environment.

 - Experience working with enterprise customers, preferably within the retail technology space.

 - Hands-on experience implementing or supporting APIs, integrations, identity management, or enterprise SaaS platforms.

 - Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, or enterprise identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Ping, etc.).

 - Experience delivering customer-facing technical implementation or professional services engagements.

 - Strong understanding of REST and/or GraphQL APIs, web services, authentication methods, and data exchange concepts.



Nice-to-Haves

 - Experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other relational databases.

 - Familiarity with Ruby on Rails or modern web application architectures.

 - Experience with data warehouses such as BigQuery.

 - Experience using project or work management platforms such as Jira/Confluence.

 - Experience supporting enterprise reporting platforms or BI tools such as Metabase.

 - Retail industry experience or experience working with retail operations teams.




COMPENSATION

At Zipline, we're committed to paying our team fairly, transparently, and in a way that supports growth. This role is targeting an annual salary within Canada of $129,122.10-$157,815.90 CAD.

The broad salary ranges reflect the growth someone will experience in the role from developing skills to reaching expertise within their career level. We've found that hiring team members with the expectation of being accomplished in the role sets them up for success, which for this position, on the Canada band is $129,122.10. Salaries below this point typically reflect someone with potential but still building the necessary skills, while salaries above are for individuals already excelling in the role, with a deep understanding of Zipline's impact on customers, product, and company.

At Zipline, you'll continue to have career development conversations with your manager to ensure your compensation grows as you advance.

Our salary ranges are determined by market, factoring in our revenue and employee size and paying competitively. In higher cost of living markets, we apply 5-10% multipliers on our ranges, depending on the location, to maintain competitive compensation and reflective of the increased expenses our team members face in those areas. While we primarily hire in Canada and the USA, we are a global employer, and all hiring regions will use the same methodology to determine fair and transparent pay.

Transparency is key to building trust in our compensation process. To better understand how this range is determined, we encourage you to ask as many questions as you'd like about compensation during the interview process to ensure clarity and confidence.




 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Remote-first culture: Join a high performing, fully remote team and work where you're comfortable.

 - Stock Options: Get meaningful ownership in a fast-growing, venture-backed company shaping the future of retail.

 - Time off: We believe rest fuels great work. Our flexible time-off policy gives you the freedom to take the breaks you need, when you need them—whether it's a long weekend or a well-deserved vacation. We'll also give you a monthly coffee-shop stipend to switch up your workspace and get inspired outside the office. And when you've been with us for five years? You'll earn a fully paid one-month sabbatical to truly unplug and reflect—we call it a thank-you for your impact and dedication.

 - Benefits: World-class medical, dental, and vision policies.

 - Team Connection: Annual company off-sites in fun locations. We've done New York, Costa Rica, Whistler, Palm Springs, San Diego, and Mexico City.

 - Volunteering: Every quarter, Zipliners get a paid day off to volunteer for a nonprofit of their choice.

 - Learning: We support continuous learning and provide unlimited access to our Udemy Business account.

 - Great humans, great work: Work with kind, collaborative teammates who care about doing meaningful work and making a real impact. We value diversity of all kinds and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of all different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.



Want to learn more about how we work?

We may be remote, but we're anything but disconnected. Zipline is a thriving, dynamic team spread across the globe—collaborating, innovating, and having a blast along the way.



Zipliners work from all over—vans, boats, Airbnbs, and everything in between. No office? No problem. Our culture still feels like one big hug.



Even though we're distributed, we make space to connect—whether it's our weekly all-company social or gathering in person at our yearly retreats. We're building something meaningful together, and we're glad you're considering being a part of it.



We can't wait to meet you!




HOW WE HIRE

We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, including helping us organize applications and identify early matches based on role criteria. That said, every rejection decision is made by a human. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and avoid relying solely on AI-generated responses, especially during interviews.



This opportunity is offered through HighlightTA, the on-demand talent team supporting Zipline’s growth.
