WE’RE LOOKING FOR A SECURITY, COMPLIANCE & IT LEADER 👋



As our Director, Enterprise Security & IT, you'll sit at the intersection of security, compliance, and IT operations. You'll be accountable for how Klue protects customer data and how every Kluebee gets equipped to do their best work. Today, these three areas sit under different teams. You'll turn them into one team with one roadmap, working alongside an Engineering org that already builds and runs our product infrastructure.



Your Mission? To own the security and compliance posture that our customers, our sales team, and our own people rely on. That covers everything we do: from building the product, to the internal automations, to the tools we use, and how we use AI. You'll set the standard, build the systems and set the rhythm to meet it. And in the process, make the secure way, the easy way.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?


You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it. You'll define the operating model, the culture, and the technical direction for a brand-new function, and shape a small, sharp team of 2 from day one. You'll report directly to the CTO and work closely with the Senior Leadership Team, as well as the Engineering, Product, Sales, and People teams. You'll tackle big questions like how to govern AI agents connected to company systems, and your answers will set policy at Klue. As Klue grows, so do the team and your scope. You have the power to shape what that looks like.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own security posture and incident readiness. Mature how Klue prevents, detects, and responds to security issues. Design the incident response process and governance, and make sure everyone knows their role before something goes wrong.

 - Run the compliance engine. Own the annual audit cycle against SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF, and BSIMM, plus penetration testing, from evidence collection to a successful finish. Build audit methodology and documentation that make reviews faster and less painful for the whole company.

 - Be the security answer for go-to-market. Keep customer questionnaires, external assessments, and audits moving on time. Review and negotiate data protection agreements and security exhibits with customers and vendors so what we sign matches what we do.

 - Govern vendors, data, and privacy. Run full-spectrum vendor reviews, including sub-processor qualification. Own DLP, data retention, and the privacy framework for an international customer base, including data subject access requests.

 - Set the rules for AI and high-risk access. Own AI security governance: policies, risk acceptance, data handling, and permissioning for AI tools, agents, and integrations connected to company systems. Define and enforce access governance for high-risk systems, including admin access reviews, service accounts vs. individual credentials, and controls on sensitive logs and data.

 - Make security engineering's job easier. Set the security and compliance standard for Engineering's security work. Give the team the tooling, policy, and guidelines to build against, and translate their technical work into terms leadership and customers can act on.

 - Equip and enable every Kluebee. Own devices, access, and tooling across the full employee lifecycle. Manage the vendors behind our IT stack, set and hit reliability targets (SLOs) for corporate systems, and replace ad hoc fixes with repeatable processes that scale. Partner with People so onboarding and offboarding run smoothly. (Product infrastructure stays with Engineering.)




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - One team, one roadmap. Within two quarters, Security, Compliance, and IT operate as one team with a shared roadmap and a regular operating rhythm.

 - Customers get fast, consistent answers. Questionnaires, audits, and sub-processor reviews are completed on time and in a repeatable way.

 - AI and access are governed, not improvised. High-risk systems and AI tools are covered by clear, documented policy, and admin access reviews are routine, not reactive.

 - Corporate systems are reliable. You define clear SLOs in your first quarter, and Klue meets or beats them.

 - We're ready when it counts. Incident response governance is documented and understood, and Engineering's security engineers have the tooling and guidelines to respond fast.

 - Day 1 just works. Every new Kluebee has working equipment and access on their first day, with no scrambling.

 - The budget is a set of clear choices. You actively manage the function's budget and make defensible tradeoffs between tooling, vendors, and headcount.

 - You're the default owner. The CTO and SLT turn to you for security, compliance, and IT. Engineering and GTM teams see you as the partner who makes their job easier, not another layer to work around.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must Haves

 - You've run security and compliance at a company handling sensitive customer data. You're comfortable owning DLP, data retention, and privacy frameworks, and you can work through a security questionnaire or audit without panic.

 - You've led IT operations for a whole company, covering equipment, access, and tooling.

 - You know security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in depth.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity and building without a playbook.

 - You communicate clearly with both technical peers and non-technical leaders, and can explain a risk to an engineer and to a CEO.

 - You've negotiated data protection agreements and security exhibits in vendor and customer contracts.

 - You understand AI security and governance: data retention commitments, access and permissioning for AI agents and integrations, and risk acceptance for AI tooling.

 - You've worked closely with product and engineering teams to turn security and compliance goals into reality.

Nice-to-Haves

 - You've owned a DevOps and/or security engineering function inside a larger engineering org.

 - You've brought previously siloed security, compliance, and IT teams together under one roof.

 - You know privacy and data residency frameworks for an international customer base.

 - You've managed distributed or hybrid teams.

Not ticking every box? That’s okay. We take potential into consideration. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of the specifics listed above. ABOUT KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.




ABOUT THE ROLE

KOHO is looking for an Analytics Engineer to build and scale the reporting pipelines and data models that power decision-making across the company. Working alongside fellow Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts, you'll partner with teams across the business - from Finance and Operations to Product, Tech, and beyond - to turn business needs into reliable, well-modelled data.



You'll own the technical backbone that makes data trustworthy and accessible, ensuring our data infrastructure keeps pace with an ambitious and fast-moving organization.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale data pipelines: Design and develop scalable data pipelines, from scoping through delivery

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with stakeholders across the business to define data requirements and translate them into technical solutions

 - Build reliable reporting infrastructure: Create performant, well-tested data models that power internal reporting, self-serve analytics, and decision-making

 - Design scalable data models: Apply modelling frameworks (one big table, entity tables, event streams, Kimball) tailored to the use case

 - Optimize and monitor: Maintain pipeline health, optimize query performance, and implement data quality monitoring

 - Enable the team: Document solutions, establish best practices, and help upskill fellow Analytics Engineers and Analysts

 - Integrate cross-functional data: Work across domain boundaries to unify data into cohesive, reusable reporting structures




WHO YOU ARE

 - 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar data roles

 - DBT expertise: Comfortable with complex DBT projects and various materializations (incremental, table, view, etc.), snapshots, variables, macros, and Jinja

 - SQL skills: Query optimization and performance tuning

 - Modern data stack: DBT Core and/or DBT Cloud, Git. A plus if experience with Redshift.

 - Collaborative: You work well alongside analysts, PMs, and engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions

 - Clear communicator: You adapt communication to different audiences and connect technical work to business outcomes

 - Takes initiative: You identify opportunities for improvement and act without waiting to be asked

 - AI-curious: Experience or interest in leveraging AI tools for development workflows. Foundations in AI-assisted development are a plus.
 
 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience in fintech or banking environments

 - Experience with highly-regulated domains
 
 

Don't meet every requirement listed above? Apply anyway if you meet most of them. We'd rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out.



The budgeted salary range for this role is $110,000 - $135,000 CAD / year. 

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.




DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS




À PROPOS DU POSTE

KOHO est à la recherche d’un·e ingénieur·e en analytique de données pour concevoir et faire évoluer les pipelines de production de rapports et les modèles de données qui soutiennent la prise de décision dans l’ensemble de l’entreprise. En collaboration avec les autres membres de l’équipe d’ingénierie analytique et les analystes de données, vous travaillerez avec différentes équipes - des Finances et des Opérations jusqu’aux équipes Produit, Technologie et autres - afin de transformer les besoins d’affaires en données fiables et bien modélisées.

Vous serez responsable des fondations techniques qui rendent les données fiables et accessibles, tout en veillant à ce que notre infrastructure de données évolue au rythme d’une organisation ambitieuse et en pleine croissance.




CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

Kong is building the future of API management for developers. We’re a fast-growing, well-funded company with happy customers and motivated employees. Insomnia, acquired in 2019, is a full-lifecycle API development platform that has quickly become an integral part of Kong’s product portfolio.
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Konnect team at Kong, you’ll architect Kong Identity's multi-tenant identity platform supporting complex organizational hierarchies, cross-tenant isolation, and enterprise-grade security controls.



What You'll Do:

 - Design and implement advanced token management systems, including refresh token rotation, proof-of-possession tokens, and custom token introspection with real-time revocation capabilities.

 - Lead development of Kong Identity's extensible claims engine supporting dynamic attribute resolution, contextual claim injection, and complex business logic evaluation at token issuance.

 - Architect global identity infrastructure with edge optimization, intelligent token caching, and cross-region replication strategies for sub-millisecond authentication latency worldwide.

 - Design sophisticated rate limiting, anomaly detection, and fraud prevention systems to protect against credential stuffing, token abuse, and distributed attacks.

 - Build enterprise identity federation capabilities, including SAML bridge patterns, external IdP chaining, and custom protocol adapters for legacy system integration.

 - Lead technical strategy for Kong Identity's developer experience, including SDKs, webhooks, audit logging, and real-time analytics dashboards for token lifecycle visibility.

 - Architect advanced client management systems supporting dynamic client registration, automated credential rotation, and programmatic policy enforcement.

 - Design Kong Identity's plugin architecture enables custom grant flows, protocol extensions, and third-party integrations while maintaining security boundaries.

 - Drive implementation of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR), including comprehensive audit trails, data residency controls, and privacy-preserving token designs.

 - Lead technical initiatives for Kong Identity's integration with observability platforms, supporting distributed tracing, metrics collection, and security event correlation.

 - Mentor engineering teams on advanced identity concepts including zero-trust architectures, workload identity, and service mesh integration patterns.
 
 

What You'll Bring:

 - 7+ years of experience building production identity platforms at leading identity providers or enterprise software companies, with proven track record of handling millions of authentication requests daily.

 - Deep expertise in advanced OAuth 2.0 extensions (PKCE, mTLS, JWT bearer assertions, token exchange), OpenID Connect profiles, and emerging standards like OAuth 2.1 and GNAP.

 - Proven experience architecting multi-tenant identity platforms with complex isolation requirements, tenant-specific configurations, and enterprise feature sets.

 - Strong background in cryptographic protocols including advanced JWT patterns, key rotation strategies, Hardware Security Module (HSM) integration, and post-quantum cryptography considerations.

 - Experience building identity platforms with sophisticated analytics, real-time monitoring, and security event detection capabilities at enterprise scale.

 - Expertise in global identity infrastructure including edge deployment strategies, geo-distributed token validation, and cross-region data consistency patterns.

 - Deep understanding of enterprise identity integration patterns including SAML federation, LDAP/AD bridges, SCIM provisioning, and custom protocol adapters.

 - Proven track record building developer-first identity platforms including comprehensive SDKs, webhook systems, and extensible API designs.

 - Experience with identity platform security including threat modeling, penetration testing coordination, and implementation of advanced attack prevention mechanisms.

 - Strong background in compliance and regulatory requirements for identity systems including audit trail design, data residency controls, and privacy engineering.

 - Experience building identity platforms supporting complex organizational structures, delegated administration, and fine-grained permission models.

 - Expertise in high-performance system design including horizontal scaling strategies, caching architectures, and latency optimization for identity operations.

 - Knowledge of service mesh identity patterns, workload identity bootstrapping, and integration with container orchestration platforms.

 - Experience with identity protocol extensions, custom grant flows, and building extensible identity platforms that support diverse use cases.

 - Proven ability to lead technical initiatives in complex, regulated environments while balancing innovation with security and compliance requirements.

Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client builds the data layer that AI agents run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, structured, LLM-ready data. It is already the default way a huge number of developers pull web data into their AI systems.

The numbers back it up: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled that in year two, and 180,000+ GitHub stars, placing its open-source project among the top 50 repositories of all time. They just closed a $75M Series B. The company is small, moving fast, and hiring people who want to build the next chapter with them.




THE MISSION

They believe developers and AI agents should not have to fight the web to get useful data out of it. Every hour spent maintaining a scraper, dealing with stale pages, or working around brittle retrieval systems is an hour taken away from the actual product.

Their job is to make that problem disappear: give AI systems reliable access to the live web, then make the results clean, current, structured, and useful enough to power real products.




THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Search Engineer, you will own ranking quality and relevance for an LLM-driven search and retrieval product.

This is a role for an engineer whose primary, hands-on discipline is production search quality. You have personally shipped ranking or re-ranking changes, measured their impact, and can clearly describe the relevance, recall, conversion, or other search-quality metric you improved—including the result.

You will work directly with the Head of Search and a small team across crawling, indexing, retrieval, and search serving. These systems are central to delivering excellent results at scale, but they are not substitutes for relevance ownership. Your role is to improve search quality while navigating the real constraints of web-scale retrieval: freshness, deduplication, latency, reliability, and cost per query.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own ranking quality and relevance for LLM-driven retrieval

 - Design and build the crawling, indexing, and retrieval systems

 - Push down latency and cost per query while search volume grows

 - Own services end to end: design, ship, monitor, and iterate in production

 - Work directly with the Head of Search and the rest of the search team on the roadmap




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years of experience building and operating search or retrieval systems in production, with ranking and relevance as your primary, owned discipline

 - A specific example of a ranking or re-ranking change you personally owned, the search-quality or business metric it moved, and the numerical impact achieved

 - Hands-on information-retrieval depth across BM25 and lexical retrieval, semantic/vector retrieval, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, retrieval evaluation, or RAG evaluation

 - Experience measuring search quality through relevance, recall, conversion, CTR, NDCG, MRR, query satisfaction, or comparable production metrics

 - End-to-end ownership of search services: you have designed, shipped, monitored, debugged, measured, and iterated on production systems

 - Strong backend systems programming skills in Go, Rust, Python, or a comparable language.

 - Experience balancing relevance, latency, cost, correctness, and reliability under real production constraints

 - Comfort working through ambiguity, setting technical direction, and shipping quickly with a build-measure-iterate operating style




KEY SUCCESS DRIVERS

The people who do well here have personally owned search quality in production, think end-to-end about relevance, crawling, indexing, serving, latency, and cost, and thrive in ambiguity by shipping, measuring, and iterating quickly without needing a fully defined playbook.




WHY JOIN?

 - Compensation & Equity: 
 
 San Francisco: $235,000–$260,000 USD base salary, plus competitive equity.
 
 Toronto: $217,000–$233,000 CAD base salary, plus competitive equity.

 - Traction: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled in year two. 180,000+ GitHub stars and a developer base showing up before you even start selling to them. $75M Series B closed in 2026, backed by top-tier investors

 - Team: ~40 people total, real visibility with the founders and leadership. No layers, no committees, fast decisions, short feedback loops

 - Benefits: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision (50% for spouse and kids); employer-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance; 401(k), pre-tax FSA, and commuter benefits; pet insurance; 15+ days PTO; 12 weeks fully paid parental leave for moms and dads; $100/month wellness stipend; $1,000/year learning and development budget; 3-month paid sabbatical after 4 years; team offsites twice a year; SF HQ perks and a loaner e-bike for commuting

 - Visa: not open to visa sponsorship on this one (Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada).




INTERVIEWING PROCESS

 1. Intro Chat

 2. Technical Chat

 3. Founders Chat

 4. Paid Work Trial (~40 hours)

We're hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to ship product features and experiments end-to-end. Your core focus areas:

 - Feature delivery across the stack in TypeScript, from React Native screens to Supabase data

 - Polished, correct UI, shipped to the standard of the design, not an approximation of it

 - Experiment infrastructure and instrumentation

 - Clean, performant API and data access

 - Cross-functional shipping with Product, Design, and Growth

This is a high-ownership role. You'll take a problem from spec to shipped, work with our existing team/resources, and own the outcome, not just your slice of it.




✅ WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Features and experiments that go out end-to-end without stalling on handoffs

 - UI that ships pixel-correct and feels right; spacing, states, edge cases, and transitions handled without needing a review pass to catch them

 - A high-velocity experiment pipeline: clean instrumentation → fast implementation → reliable measurement → iteration

 - A product that stays fast and stable as usage grows; schema changes land safely, queries stay efficient

 - Shipped improvements that compound (reusable experiment patterns, better event tracking, faster deploys, fewer incidents)

 - Strong operating cadence with crisp communication on what's shipping, why, and what it did




🛠️ WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Ship features end-to-end
 
 - Build the front end in TypeScript with React Native (Expo); typed, readable, and maintainable by the next person
 
 - Implement designs faithfully: correct spacing and type, all states (loading, empty, error), and the edge cases the mock doesn't show
 
 - Write and run migrations and deploy schema changes safely; keep the data model clean as the product grows
 
 - Stay conscious of load and performance - catch the slow query or the runaway request pattern before users do

 - Ship experiments and instrumentation
 
 - Partner with Product/Growth to implement A/B tests and feature flags via Statsig
 
 - Ensure every experiment has clean event tracking and reliable data
 
 - Build reusable patterns that reduce experiment cycle time

 - Use data to drive decisions
 
 - Instrument events properly so the team can trust experiment results
 
 - Spot measurement issues (leaky cohorts, misconfigured flags, underpowered tests) before they corrupt decisions

 - Collaborate cross-functionally
 
 - Work with Product and Growth to align experiment implementation with the roadmap
 
 - Work with Design to turn Figma into shipped UI in React Native / Expo
 
 - Contribute to prioritization by bringing technical feasibility and effort estimates




🔍 YOU’LL LIKELY SUCCEED IF YOU HAVE

We don’t expect you to check every box. We care most about ownership, judgment, and shipping.

 - Professional full-stack experience shipping to production

 - Strong TypeScript — it's the language of the whole stack here, front end included

 - Comfort on both sides: modern front-end (React / React Native or similar) and Node.js against a relational database (Postgres preferred)

 - A real eye for detail; noticing unwanted 4px gaps, missing empty states, animation stutters, and fixing it without being asked

 - Working knowledge of schema design, migrations, and query performance, enough to make changes safely without needing a specialist

 - Hands-on experience with experimentation infrastructure: feature flags, A/B tests, event tracking

 - Demonstrated ability to ship autonomously in a fast-paced, low-structure environment

 - Clear written communication; can document decisions, write specs, and share learnings




🌱 BONUS ATTRIBUTES

 - UX instinct — you can tell when a flow doesn't feel right, not just when it doesn't match the spec, and you can articulate why and push back on a design

 - Experience with our specific stack: Supabase, Vercel, tRPC, Statsig, RevenueCat

 - Background in subscription/consumer apps — understanding of trials, paywalls, LTV, ARPU

 - Experience with AI-assisted development workflows

 - Prior experience at a fast-moving startup where you wore multiple hats

 - Motion/animation implementation (Rive or similar)




🧰 TOOLS & TECH STACK

You don't need prior experience with every tool, but you should be excited to learn and ship in this stack.

 - Language: TypeScript, end to end

 - App: React Native (Expo)

 - Frontend: Figma, Rive

 - Backend: Supabase, Vercel, tRPC, Node.js

 - Monetization: RevenueCat, Superwall

 - Experimentation / Analytics: Statsig




🙌 AT LIFTOFF, YOU’LL ENJOY

 - Autonomy and Ownership: you are in charge of your time at Liftoff. Decide what you want to do, align with leadership, and go for it.

 - Top-of-the-Market Cash & Equity Compensation: we pay for high performers.

 - A World-Class Team: low-ego, high standards, and real ownership.




🤝 INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Hiring Manager Screening

 2. Take-Home Challenge (backend task + frontend implementation)

 3. Technical Deep Dive (live walkthrough + system design extension)

 4. Work week trial (paid - simulating real work environment)




💰 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Competitive cash (based on level and scope)

 - Company-paid lunch every day (if you’re in office)

 - Lifetime Liftoff Pro membership




🌍 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We hire and grow talent based on strengths, potential, and performance, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.




🚀 TO APPLY, WE WANT

 - Your portfolio showing projects, games, or apps you've built

 - Your resume, and LinkedIn/Github profile

 - A few lines on why this role

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a Principal Product Designer — a rare, senior individual-contributor role reporting directly to the Head of Design for Retail. Lightspeed AI is our biggest bet: an intelligence layer that acts like a partner for every merchant, evolving from an assistant that answers questions into an agent that takes action. Almost nothing about designing this experience has an established playbook — how merchants delegate work to an agent, supervise it, learn to trust it, and stay in control. You'll help write that playbook.

The role has two centers of gravity. First, leading design for our agentic AI experience — the defining product challenge of the next several years. Second, raising the craft bar across the entire Retail design organization: not by writing standards, but by making things — designing alongside teams in every product area to show, concretely, what great looks like. You'll also help shape our mobile point-of-sale strategy as a secondary focus.

This is not a management role. It's for a maker who moves fluidly between defining strategy and pushing pixels — someone who can hold the full context of a large product portfolio and still be the strongest hands-on designer in the room.

Location: Toronto preferred; open to other locations in Ontario, Quebec and Eastern Canada.

What you'll be doing:

 - Define new interaction patterns for agentic AI — designing how merchants converse with, direct, supervise, and build trust in an intelligent agent that works on their behalf.

 - Lead design for our AI experience end-to-end as a hands-on IC: from concept and prototype through polished, shipped product, in close partnership with AI engineering and product leadership.

 - Raise the craft bar across the organization through direct contribution — jumping into any product area to explore, elevate, and unblock the most important work, and leaving teams stronger than you found them.

 - Lead vision work that rethinks core merchant experiences through hands-on exploration and prototyping — concept work ambitious enough to shape strategy and concrete enough to build.

 - Prototype with AI, daily: work AI-first — using modern tools to move from intent to working prototype fast — and model this way of working for designers across the org.

 - Shape our mobile strategy with design thinking and hands-on support, as an ongoing secondary focus.

 - Influence without authority: align designers, leaders, and cross-functional partners across multiple teams through clarity, storytelling, and the quality of the work itself.

What you need to bring:

 - 12+ years of product design experience with a maker's mindset — moving fluidly between strategic thinking and detailed, polished execution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional hands-on craft across UX, interaction, and visual design — work that other designers point to.

 - Experience leading large, ambiguous initiatives across multiple teams and delivering measurable outcomes — without formal authority.

 - Genuine fluency with AI: active use of LLMs and AI prototyping tools in your workflow, and a strong point of view on designing AI-powered products.

 - Enough technical understanding to be a real partner to engineers — you can build prototypes to communicate ideas and reason about constraints.

 - The ability to influence senior stakeholders through clear communication, storytelling, and tangible design work.

 - Taste. You know what great looks and feels like, and you push — and help others push — to get there.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to help shape the architecture and technical direction of Lightspeed’s Retail Point of Sale experience—the software merchants rely on to run their stores, serve their customers, and keep their businesses moving.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role. You’ll work across teams to make the POS more reliable, scalable, performant, and easier to evolve. You’ll personally contribute to the most important technical problems while raising the quality of engineering across Retail through clear technical leadership, strong judgment, and practical mentorship.

You’ll help us build software that works in the real world: across devices, hardware, networks, payments, inventory, and the many edge cases that make retail challenging. You’ll bring a systems perspective to complex problems while staying close enough to the work to understand the details and help teams deliver.


WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Setting and communicating the architectural direction for key areas of Retail Point of Sale.

 - Ensuring that systems supporting new POS capabilities are well-designed, secure, scalable, observable, and resilient.

 - Helping teams design reliable experiences across checkout, hardware, network connectivity, payments, sales, inventory, and order workflows.

 - Leading architectural deep-dives and identifying opportunities to simplify systems, reduce duplication, improve performance, and lower operational risk.

 - Driving improvements in reliability, availability, latency, and recovery—especially in the moments that matter most to merchants and their customers.

 - Identifying recurring sources of incidents, customer pain, and non-project overhead, then creating practical plans to address them.

 - Establishing and evolving engineering practices across design, testing, deployment, observability, incident management, and technical decision-making.

 - Partnering with Product, Design, Support, and other engineering leaders to turn ambiguous business and customer problems into sound technical direction.

 - Mentoring senior engineers and technical leaders, helping them grow their scope and make better decisions independently.

 - Creating alignment across teams without relying on formal authority, and making thoughtful trade-offs between immediate delivery and long-term platform health.

 - Contributing to the wider Retail Engineering organization wherever your experience can create leverage.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Significant experience designing and building business-critical software systems in production.

 - A track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or a broad product area.

 - Experience shaping architecture across a large, evolving system with meaningful scale and operational complexity.

 - Experience building and operating cloud-based systems with strong expectations for reliability, security, and performance.

 - A history of delivering important outcomes under challenging timelines and incomplete information.

 - Strong systems-thinking skills, with the ability to move between product intent, architecture, implementation details, and operational reality.

 - Experience working across more than one technology stack or technical layer. Our environment includes backend services, web and mobile clients, data stores, APIs, event-driven systems, and infrastructure.

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and decisions concise.

 - The judgment to moderate technical conversations, navigate disagreement, and move groups toward decisions.

 - A hands-on approach. You don’t need to write every line of code, but you should be comfortable going deep, prototyping, reviewing designs, and contributing directly when it matters.


EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE, BUT IT’S NOT REQUIRED

 - Experience building point-of-sale, commerce, ecommerce, payments, inventory, or other transaction-heavy systems.

 - Deep experience with distributed systems, offline-capable software, multi-region systems, or high-availability platforms.

 - Experience working with hardware integrations, payment terminals, peripherals, or environments with unreliable network connectivity.

 - Strong understanding of domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, data consistency, and migration strategies.

 - Experience improving a large or legacy system through incremental modernization rather than a risky rewrite.

 - Experience leading technical work across web, backend, mobile, and platform teams.

 - Experience with people management or formal technical leadership responsibilities.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You care deeply about the customer and understand that technical decisions should make merchants’ work simpler and more dependable.

 - You are energized by complex systems and can make them easier for others to understand and improve.

 - You combine high standards with pragmatism. You know when to invest in the foundation and when to make a focused trade-off to keep moving.

 - You lead through influence, clarity, and trust rather than title.

 - You are comfortable being accountable for outcomes that extend beyond your immediate team.

 - You seek out difficult problems, step into ambiguity, and create momentum.

 - You are a generous technical partner who makes the people around you stronger.

 - You communicate directly and respectfully, especially when the stakes are high or opinions differ.

 - You stay curious, learn from what happens in production, and continuously improve your own judgment.

 - As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.



To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.




WHERE TO FROM HERE?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here https://www.lightspeedhq.com/careers/.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.




WHO WE ARE: 

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement https://www.lightspeedhq.com/legal/applicant-privacy-statement/.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to join our Product & Technology Operations team and own how we manage, optimize, and scale cloud, vendor, and AI spend across the organization.

You will define the FinOps strategy itself - not just run an existing cost program, but decide what gets optimized, in what order, and why. Cloud and vendor cost management has an established playbook that we want to scale and automate; AI spend does not. You'll be defining and building FinOps for AI, while also evolving existing practice into a more automated system.

This is a very senior technical IC role. You'll bring enough technical depth to build or directly shape the automations, dashboards, and optimization recommendations yourself, and enough strategic judgment to influence how leadership thinks about cost trade-offs and how we partner with Finance, Procurement and other functions on all things vendor management and optimizations.



What you’ll be doing:

Define the FinOps strategy

 - Own the strategy for cloud, vendor, and AI cost management across the organization - not just the execution of an existing roadmap.

 - Continuously reassess what to optimize, in what order, and why, based on where spend and risk are actually concentrated.

 - Build the framework for managing AI cost, an area with no established industry playbook yet.

Drive cost optimization with technical depth

 - Analyze cloud usage, vendor contracts, and AI spend to identify inefficiencies and develop strategies to reduce unnecessary cost.

 - Build or directly shape the dashboards, automations, and monitoring systems that make cost visible and actionable, at a technical depth equivalent to a Senior Engineer.

 - Propose specific technical optimizations, not just process recommendations, and know when a suggestion requires deeper engineering partnership.

 - Apply hands-on experience building and automating with AI, not just directing others to do it.

Lead the program across the organization

 - Oversee and in some cases execute multiple cost-optimization initiatives simultaneously.

 - Own the reporting structure - cost attribution, monitoring, and alerting - and use it to tell leadership a clear, trustworthy story about spend and savings.

 - Partner with FP&A to define and establish key cost metrics giving leadership a sharper financial lens on cost efficiency.

 - Manage cross-functional dependencies, risk, and change across SRE, Engineering, Data, FP&A, and Procurement teams.

Influence at the executive level

 - Bring insights on feasibility, timelines, risk, and cost trade-offs directly to senior and executive stakeholders, shaping decisions that affect real budget and infrastructure choices.

 - Balance centralized cost management standards with the autonomy individual business units need to operate effectively.

 - Proactively surface issues and advocate for change across products and teams, rather than waiting to be asked.

Mentorship

 - Partner with Delivery Ops leadership on TPM career development, best practices, and the foundation of the broader TPM function.

 - Mentor other TPMs, helping raise the technical and strategic bar across the team.



What you need to bring:

 - Experience owning both the strategy and execution for a cloud, vendor or AI cost optimization program - not just executing one someone else designed.

 - Deep knowledge of the AI vendor landscape - pricing models, contract structures, and the specific optimization levers and nuances that differ from traditional cloud cost management.

 - Technical depth in cloud architecture, cost management, and optimization techniques strong enough to build or directly evaluate dashboards and automation yourself.

 - Experience navigating an area with no established playbook, building the framework as you go rather than applying a known model.

 - A track record of running large, cross-organizational programs spanning multiple business units.

 - Strong executive communication skills - able to translate complex technical and cost trade-offs into decisions leadership can act on.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive change across an organization without formal authority over them.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!



Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

 - A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

 - A culture that celebrates performance

 - The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

 - Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

 - Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

 - Equity options, because this is your company too

 - Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

 - Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

 - Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

 - Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

 - Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

 - Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

 - Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
 
 

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a Product Manager II to join our Wholesale Network team. You will own the insights and analytics features for our Wholesale Network and NuORDER platform; the tools that help brands and retailers understand how their businesses are performing and where to grow. This is a high-visibility role with direct influence on network health, brand retention, and the value proposition of Lightspeed's wholesale ecosystem.

The ideal candidate thinks rigorously about data, builds strong relationships with customers and internal teams, and knows how to turn complex signals into clear product direction. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market partners to deliver analytics capabilities that matter to the people using them every day.

If you are a dedicated problem-solver ready to make a meaningful impact at scale, this role is for you.

What you’ll be doing:

 - Define and prioritize: Own and drive the product strategy for wholesale insights and analytics, connecting your roadmap to measurable outcomes for brands, retailers, and the network.

 - Discover and validate: Conduct ongoing discovery with brands and retailers to understand how they measure performance, where current reporting falls short, and what decisions they need better data to make.

 - Translate complexity: Work closely with engineering and data teams to translate complex data models and reporting requirements into clear, well-scoped product direction.

 - Measure and iterate: Define success metrics for every initiative, measure outcomes after launch, and use evidence to inform what comes next.

 - Partner across the business: Collaborate with go-to-market, customer success, and strategic brand partners to ensure insights features are adopted, understood, and driving value.

 - Work across the platform: Identify and manage dependencies with adjacent product surfaces, including platform data infrastructure, the buyer experience, and AI-powered wholesale capabilities.

 - Raise the bar: Contribute to broader team and organizational objectives beyond your immediate squad.

How you’ll know you’re thriving in this role:

 - Brands and retailers can answer meaningful questions about their business using the tools you ship.

 - Your roadmap reflects a coherent point of view, not just a list of feature requests.

 - Engineers and designers understand the problem, feel ownership over the solution, and are not waiting for direction.

 - You make well-reasoned tradeoffs between customer impact, data complexity, and delivery timelines.

 - Stakeholders trust your judgment and rely on you to synthesize signal across customer research, usage data, and business context.

 - Shipped work leads to measurable improvements in how brands and retailers engage with the network.

What you need to bring:

We're looking for candidates who have experience with the following:

 - 3+ years of product management experience, with a track record of delivering data-driven or analytics-facing products in a B2B SaaS environment.

 - Strong analytical thinking, including comfort working with KPIs, data models, and product metrics to validate hypotheses and inform decisions.

 - Experience conducting customer discovery (interviews, surveys, usability sessions) and translating qualitative and quantitative feedback into product direction.

 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams in a cross-functional, distributed environment.

 - Strong prioritization skills and comfort making tradeoffs with incomplete information.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor messages for technical teams, senior stakeholders, and customers alike.

 - Familiarity with Agile product development practices and modern product tooling.

Even better if you have, but not required:

 - Experience building or owning reporting, BI, or dashboard products.

 - SQL proficiency or hands-on experience working with data teams on data models and pipelines.

 - Understanding of wholesale, retail, or merchandising workflows; how brands sell to retailers and how buyers make purchasing decisions.

 - Familiarity with AI or recommendation system concepts as applied to business intelligence or analytics products.

What's in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

 - Lots of autonomy, flexible work culture, and the option of fully remote work

 - Genuine career opportunities in a company that is creating new roles every day

 - Work on a product used by thousands of brands and retailers across the wholesale industry

 - Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

… and enjoy a range of benefits that will keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

 - Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

 - Flexible paid time off policy

 - Extended healthcare benefits

 - Health and wellness benefit of $500 per year

 - Mental health online platform and counseling & coaching services

 - Paid leave and assistance for new parents

 - LinkedIn Learning license

 - Volunteer day

We know that people are more than what's on their CV. If you're unsure that you have the right profile for the role… hit the 'Apply' button and let's have a chat!

 

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $115,000 TO $125,000 CAD. Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! 

We are looking for a Senior iOS Developer to join one of our squads where you will be supporting Lightspeed’s Hospitality product group on the mission to expand our reach into new markets and countries while enhancing our advanced hospitality commerce platform.

For this role specifically, you will be joining the team focused on the Lightspeed POS that enables customers to optimize their business workflows. Our mission is to make sure that our flagship product is perfect for our target audience in EMEA and NOAM markets and provides a variety of integrations with our partners.

You will join a healthy and collaborative team, continuously improving our engineering practices, and delivering state-of-the-art technology, all while keeping it fun. Above all, your work will change the way restaurateurs across the world experience hospitality.

Please note this role is based in Canada. 

What you’ll be doing:

 - Collaborate with some of the industry's top talents to enhance our iOS app by developing innovative features and user-centric workflows.

 - Design and implement elegant, efficient, and functional mobile applications tailored for iOS devices using SwiftUI.

 - Prioritize daily activities between the development of new features and the maintenance of existing integrations, with a strong focus on expanding our presence in new markets through novel iOS capabilities.

 - Report to the squad’s Team Lead and maintain active engagement with Product Managers, Designers, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and performance within the POS application.

 - Participate in daily Agile ceremonies, engage in grooming sessions, and execute cutting-edge solutions that enhance user engagement.

 - Champion high standards in code quality and system reliability, take ownership of the codebase, and contribute to the robustness of our infrastructure.

 - Elevate the team's performance by sharing insights, adopting best practices in iOS development, and continually seeking ways to innovate and improve our app.

Feel free to take a look at our Tech Stack here https://stackshare.io/lightspeed/hospitality.

What you need to bring:

 - Advanced programming skills in SwiftUI

 - Good knowledge of Structured Concurrency, Blockchain, UIKit, Swift, SQLite, Core Data, REST APIs

 - Good knowledge of Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines

 - Experience in writing automated unit and functional tests

 - Good conceptual understanding of software design and code quality

 - Experience with local network communication, external hardware accessories (e.g. payment terminals, printers) is a plus

 - Experience with use of AI tools and implementation of agentic workflows

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

 - A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

Lightspeed is looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Capital Advances team. This squad builds and runs the machinery behind Lightspeed Capital, from the moment a merchant applies for an advance, through underwriting, to the advance being issued and repaid. Much of that surface is internal, the tooling and automation our underwriting and operations teams rely on to process advances at volume, sitting alongside the merchant facing moments at either end. The work blends complex operational workflows with high stakes merchant experiences, and there is real room to turn a slow, manual process into a fast and largely automated one. In this role, you'll help define a vision through iterative design and delivery.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of transforming complex workflows into simple, clear customer journeys with user-friendly interfaces that seamlessly integrate with other workflows. You excel at identifying opportunities to deliver value and thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with engineers and product managers to create exceptional customer experiences.

Location: Please note that Lightspeed is specifically seeking candidates who are based in the Eastern Time Zone (ET), with a requirement for candidates to be located on the East Coast of Canada.

 What you’ll be doing:

 - Problem Solving: Lead project work from a design perspective with autonomy and authority, facilitating design reviews and working sessions to help the teams deliver the best possible solutions. Being comfortable to work with ambiguity and able to turn nebulous concepts into specific ideas that are useful and delightful product features, as well as finding design moves that support the vision of automating business operation with AI. Ideally has deep domain knowledge and business acumen on lending product business operation, customer onboarding, credit product underwriting process.

 - Designing with AI: You treat AI as part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. We see three places it changes design here: synthesizing complex, varied data into insight that sharpens our read of the problem space, using agentic workflows to spin up working prototypes fast, and staying in the build loop by shaping the prompts and instructions the team uses to develop experiences in production.

 - Embedding Systems Thinking: Have UX expertise and deep understanding of design systems, UI design, and how micro-interactions can help users complete a task. Design holistic systems, flows and interfaces across two very different surfaces, the internal tooling our underwriting and operations teams work in every day and the merchant experiences at either end of an advance, keeping them coherent with each other.

 - Driving User-Centricity: Draw insights from research and data, and know how to turn those insights into tangible solutions. Learn the day to day of the people who underwrite and service advances as closely as you learn the merchant's, and advocate for both when collaborating with cross-functional teams in product, engineering, risk, and operations.

We are looking for a hands-on ServiceNow Developer to join our IT Platform team. This person will own the day-to-day configuration, development, and support of our ServiceNow instance, working across ITSM & HRSD while helping extend the platform through custom development and third-party integrations. This is a highly technical, delivery-focused role for someone who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and continuously improving a mission-critical enterprise platform.

You'll work across our development, staging, and production instances, partner closely with IT and business stakeholders, and help drive our upgrade and enhancement roadmap forward.


What you’ll be doing:

 - Develop and configure ServiceNow: Build and maintain applications, catalog items, record producers, workflows, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, UI Actions, and other platform components.

 - Build integrations: Design, develop, and troubleshoot integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, webhooks, Integration Hub, MCP, and iPaaS platforms such as Workato.

 - Maintain and optimize the platform: Monitor platform health, troubleshoot performance issues, optimize scripts and flows, and ensure solutions remain scalable and maintainable.

 - Support ServiceNow applications like ITSM & HRSD: Help deliver and improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and HR-related workflows and automations.

 - Manage access and security: Administer roles, ACLs, permissions, and other platform access controls in line with security and audit requirements.

 - Resolve complex issues: Act as an escalation point for platform-level incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with infrastructure, security, vendors, and other technical teams when issues span multiple systems.

 - Deliver enhancements and projects: Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, design solutions, and take work through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.

 - Drive platform consistency: Establish reusable development patterns and standards for workflows, notifications, approvals, documentation, and user experiences.

 - Support upgrades and releases: Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, test upgrades, remediate breaking changes, and adopt relevant new platform capabilities.

 - Document and enable: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, integration documentation, and user procedures, and provide support or training when needed.

What you need to bring:

 - Hands-on experience developing and administering ServiceNow, ideally across ITSM and/or HRSD.

 - Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow scripting APIs such as GlideRecord and GlideAjax.

 - Experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Service Catalog development.

 - Experience designing and troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, OAuth, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.

 - Strong understanding of ITSM processes and how they translate into ServiceNow solutions.

 - Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues across ServiceNow and connected systems.

 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

 - Experience working with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

 - Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have's

 - Experience with HRSD, ITOM, Workday, or identity/HR platforms.

 - Experience with ServiceNow AI/GenAI capabilities, including Now Assist.

 - Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and MCP-enabled tools or workflows.

 - Experience with Service Portal, custom widgets, HTML, and CSS.

 - Experience with Workato or other iPaaS platforms.

 - ServiceNow CSA or CAD, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

 - Support upgrades and releases: Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, test upgrades, remediate breaking changes, and adopt relevant new platform capabilities.

 - Document and enable: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, integration documentation, and user procedures, and provide support or training when needed.

What you need to bring:

 - Hands-on experience developing and administering ServiceNow, ideally across ITSM and/or HRSD.

 - Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow scripting APIs such as GlideRecord and GlideAjax.

 - Experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Service Catalog development.

 - Experience designing and troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, OAuth, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.

 - Strong understanding of ITSM processes and how they translate into ServiceNow solutions.

 - Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues across ServiceNow and connected systems.

 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

 - Experience working with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

 - Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have's

 - Experience with HRSD, ITOM, Workday, or identity/HR platforms.

 - Experience with ServiceNow AI/GenAI capabilities, including Now Assist.

 - Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and MCP-enabled tools or workflows.

 - Experience with Service Portal, custom widgets, HTML, and CSS.

 - Experience with Workato or other iPaaS platforms.

 - ServiceNow CSA or CAD, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

 - A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

 - A culture that celebrates performance

 - The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

 - Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

 - Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

 - Equity options, because this is your company too

 - Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

 - Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

 - Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

 - Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

 - Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

 - Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

 - Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities. 

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to join our Retail point-of-sale design team in Montreal. You'll design for products that tens of thousands of merchants rely on every single day to run their stores — where a confusing flow isn't an inconvenience, it's a line of customers at the counter. Design at this scale is a different sport: every improvement lands with enormous reach, and every decision has to earn the trust of people whose livelihood runs through our software.

This is a role for a designer who finds the hard problems more interesting than the shiny ones: simplifying deeply established workflows without breaking what merchants depend on, finding elegant solutions within real technical constraints, and knowing when familiarity is a feature — and when it's holding users back.

Location: Montreal (HQ) preferred, working in-office alongside the team; open to other locations in eastern Canada.

What you'll be doing:

You will own how work flows from idea to impact across the organization - one language for how work moves, one set of metrics leaders can trust, and one standard for what "good" looks like at every stage of PDLC.

This is a founding role for the function. You'll define the model, align stakeholders around it, and prove out its value as you build.




What you’ll be doing:

Define the execution model

 - Design a PDLC framework that works across Product, Engineering, and Design and across all Lightspeed products.

 - Define what good looks like at each stage of PDLC, including the artifacts, checkpoints, and exit criteria teams should use.

Build the measurement system

 - Establish metrics that give leaders a trustworthy, holistic view of how work is flowing and where it's getting stuck.

 - Design the framework so it measures the system and surfaces bottlenecks, not individual performance.

 - Build in exception tracking so blocked or off-track work is visible early.

Drive adoption

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders across every vertical to align on the model and earn genuine buy-in and adoption.

 - Navigate real differences across verticals and business units without forcing false consistency where it doesn't make sense.

 - Bring structure to ambiguity - resolve open questions as they surface rather than waiting for a perfect spec.

 - Define what humans own versus what AI agents own at each stage of PDLC, keeping judgment, accountability, and anything irreversible or customer-facing with humans.

 - Partner with Engineering to identify where AI agents can accelerate delivery, build pilots, and measure their ROI and impact on speed.

 - Ensure human checkpoints are genuine decisions, not rubber stamps, as adoption scales.

Evolve the model

 - Treat the framework as a living system - review it periodically and adjust based on what's actually working.

 - Report on program health and progress to senior leadership.

 - Experience designing or significantly evolving a delivery framework, execution model, or program management system - not just operating one someone else built.

 - Experience leading cross-functional organizations through operational change, including turning skepticism into genuine adoption.

 - A track record of building measurement systems from ambiguous or inconsistent data, and knowing which problems to solve first versus defer.

jobs.position: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - French (Canada) - Remote
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity




WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER 

 - Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

 - Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

 - Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

 - Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.





JOIN A HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAM

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.




OUR CULTURE

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.




AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER SPECIALIZING IN GOLANG, YOU WILL PLAY A PIVOTAL ROLE IN DEVELOPING SOUTHBOUND CONNECTORS THAT ENABLE LITMUS EDGE TO COMMUNICATE RELIABLY WITH PLCS, INDUSTRIAL CONTROL SYSTEMS, AND IIOT DEVICES.

You'll work at the intersection of modern software engineering and industrial automation, solving complex communication challenges across a wide range of protocols, devices, and manufacturing environments. Your work will directly enable customers to securely connect their factory-floor systems to the Litmus platform.

You won't get bored in this role — you'll be exposed to a constantly evolving range of protocols, devices, and industrial environments across industries. You'll work with an exceptional team using modern tools to push the boundaries of industrial communication, speed, and reliability.

What You'll Do:

 - Develop primarily Golang-based southbound connectors that communicate directly with PLCs and industrial control systems using protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and DNP3.

 - Implement robust error handling and fault-tolerance mechanisms to ensure connectors are resilient to failures in OT environments and deliver a seamless user experience.

 - Troubleshoot and optimize connector performance, reliability, and communication across diverse industrial environments.

 - Design and implement comprehensive testing, diagnostics, logging, and monitoring to identify and resolve communication issues across diverse OT environments.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Managers, OT/Controls Engineers, and other Software Engineers — to understand requirements and deliver high-quality integration solutions.

 - Contribute to the development of our open-source projects, sharing expertise with the wider developer community.

What We're Looking For:


MUST HAVES:

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

 - Hands-on experience developing software integrations, connectors, or drivers for PLCs and industrial control systems, with practical knowledge of industrial protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, or PROFINET.

 - Strong proficiency in Golang.

 - 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience.

 - Deep understanding of networking concepts, real-time communication, and industrial automation environments.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineers from both software and industrial automation backgrounds.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with C++

 - Experience with MQTT, REST, SOAP, and other communication protocols.

LOCALSTACK - THE LOCAL CLOUD SANDBOX FOR DEVELOPERS AND AI AGENTS

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook https://localstack.notion.site/candidate-handbook-x-localstack and our GitHub https://github.com/localstack/localstack!

 - Own TGTM strategy, leading the growing team of SEs + TAMs, while being involved in strategic accounts

 - KPIs: set core metrics for technical win rate, sales-cycle velocity, adoption, and expansion.

 - Build TGTM playbook: repeatable demo/POC frameworks, reference architectures, competitive positioning, and reusable technical content.

 - Partner cross functionally with wider Revenue, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Operations teams to deliver customer insights, proactively address feature gaps, and capture new market opportunities.

 - Represent LocalStack technically with senior (VP+/CTO) stakeholders and in the broader developer community

✅ Experience we expect you to bring to the role

 - 8–12+ years of professional experience, including 3–5+ years leading TGTM (SE or TAM) teams in devtooling or adjacent space

 - Proven track record of managing enterprise sales ($250K+)

 - Deep technical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies (strong AWS skills strongly preferred).

 - Hands-on with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and application development frameworks (e.g., Terraform, CDK, Pulumi, Serverless).

 - Experience in a startup / scale-up ecosystem (preferred).

🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack

 - Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes

 - Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.

 - Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.

 - Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.

 - Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.
 

🎁 Benefits

 - Fully remote

 - Competitive salary

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k and private medical

 - Annual company retreat

 - 2 extra company-wide holidays

 - Friendly and inclusive workplace culture (community guilds and online company events)


SOUNDS LIKE A GOOD MATCH?

If your profile looks like a good match, our talent team will be in touch to organize further steps within 2 weeks.
